chunks: And with this chain, from al-Husayn ibn Yazid, from Sayf ibn 'Umayra, from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'What will Allah do to the pilgrims?' He said, 'They are forgiven, by Allah are forgiven; I do not exclude any from them.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for pilgrims according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Thawab al-Amal*, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) affirms that Allah grants forgiveness to all pilgrims without exception, highlighting the universal scope of divine mercy associated with the Hajj ritual. This statement underscores the spiritual efficacy of the pilgrimage as a means of expiation, a concept deeply rooted in Shia hadith literature regarding the transformative power of fulfilling religious duties with sincerity.
